summary: Comprehensive testing of expense deduplication/reconciliation bug fix and treasury alerts. All 12 backend tests passed. Frontend UI verified working correctly.
seed_data_creation: Created and cleaned up test expense for reconciliation verification
context_for_next_testing_agent: Deduplication and reconciliation features fully tested and working. Treasury alerts working with idempotent notifications.

fiscal_bank_reconciliation.details: Creating fiscal expense then bank expense with same value/date results in reconciled_existing action. Single canonical expense maintained with both fiscal_document_history and bank_movement_history.

hard_duplicate_blocking.details: Attempting to create exact duplicate (same date + invoice_number + value) returns 409 with code 'duplicate_invoice' and full details of existing expense.

sync_preview_structure.details: Bank analysis sync_preview correctly shows pending items with will_reconcile field. Items without matching fiscal expenses show will_reconcile=null.

sync_expenses_endpoint.details: POST /api/bank-analysis/{id}/sync-expenses returns created, reconciled, and skipped counts.

treasury_notifications.details: GET /api/notifications returns treasury type notifications. Currently showing 'Saldo em risco nos próximos 30 dias' alert.

treasury_insights.details: GET /api/bank-analysis/treasury/insights returns projection with lowest_balance=-3266.03€, status=critical, next_shortfall=2026-08-07.

notifications_bell_ui.details: NotificationsBell component correctly displays treasury type notifications with yellow warning icon.

analise_bancaria_page.details: Page loads correctly with sync approval panel showing pending items. Treasury radar strip visible on dashboard.
